messages:
Anya: Heads up — we have a new model candidate to onboard: sora-8b-open (community release). Need a pragmatic quantization & calibration roadmap (gguf, int8, fp8) so we can estimate perf/cost/quality tradeoffs and gating.
Kai: +1. Do we have an initial eval corpus? golden prompts + adversarial?
Anya: Yes — 2k golden QA/instruction prompts + 500 adversarial hallucination probes. Priya exported the set to s3:/repro/sora8b/onboard/2026-03.
Marcos: Quick notes from infra: baseline (fp32) run on a single A10: lat=210ms/token median for 512 context. Ballpark numbers to compare against.
Priya: Proposed plan: 1) gguf float16 build for parity smoke tests 2) int8 asymmetric (per-channel) with per-layer calibration 3) fp8 (recipe from our fp8-service) 4) hybrid gguf-int8 (KV cache in fp16) — run short QA/eval and cost bench.
Kai: Love the stepwise approach. For calibration datasets: use 10k calibration tokens split across domain buckets (chat, code, summarization). Keep a fixed seed.
Marcos: Ops question: how much memory headroom do we need for fp8 vs int8? I can provision test slots but need expected GPU memory delta. Priya: Expect ~1.8x memory reduction int8 vs fp16, fp8 ~2.7x reduction but slower kernel maturity.
Anya: Gating criteria proposal: - Quality: BERTScore drop <=1.5% AND instruction pass-rate drop <=2% relative to fp16 baseline
Anya: - Cost: token cost reduction >=40% vs fp16 (int8 target), fp8 target >=60%
Kai: Add latency SLO: p95 generation latency not to exceed +30% over fp16 for tail-sensitive routes.
Priya: Eval harness commands (smoke):
```
# build gguf float16
python tools/convert.py --model sora-8b --out /tmp/sora8b-fp16.gguf
# run eval (100 prompts)
python eval/run_eval.py --model /tmp/sora8b-fp16.gguf --prompts s3://repro/sora8b/prompts/quick-100.json --out /tmp/out-fp16.json
```
Marcos: For int8 calibration we'll run:
```
python quantize/quantize.py --model sora-8b --mode int8 --calib s3://repro/sora8b/calib/10k.json --out /tmp/sora8b-int8.gguf
```
Marcos: Also will add microbench script to collect tokens/sec, host CPU, and nvlink usage.
Kai: What about golden/adversarial acceptance thresholds? We should flag hallucination ratio >1% as blocking.
Priya: Agree. Also add semantic regression alerts: if a curated holdout of 200 safety/instruction examples falls below expected answer type (binary pass/fail), mark as fail.
Anya: Rollout plan idea: canary on non-critical internal route -> 10% traffic for 48h -> auto-rollback on regression -> expand to 50% -> full. Keep model pinned with fallback to fp16.
Kai: We should track per-route token cost delta (token-level accounting). If a route's cost falls but quality suffers, we need a cost-quality slider in console.
Priya: Calibration tips: - use representative rolling window (not just docs) - avoid extreme length distribution in calibrator - run 3 independent seeds for int8 to estimate noise.
Marcos: I'll schedule GPU slots tomorrow for fp16 smoke + int8 calib. Need someone to own fp8 experiments (kernel availability uncertain).
Anya: I can own fp8 prototyping. I’ll try hybrid approach next week and post results here.
EvalBot: AGENT: scheduled eval job sora-8b/fp16-smoke (100 prompts) — job_id=eval-20260318-11 — started.
Anya: Thanks — timeline target: smoke + int8 calibration by Fri, fp8/hybrid exploration next Tue. Anyone want to add anything to the checklist?
Kai: Add: deterministic seed logging, version the gguf artifact with git sha + quant-recipe hash, and store perf traces in observability.
Priya: Also ensure we capture KV-cache correctness: compare 1-step incremental outputs vs cold run for a subset.
Marcos: Noted. I'll add a small KV-check harness that diffs outputs after 50 tokens.
Anya: Great. I'll post a concise checklist later (artifact names, thresholds, commands). For now, ack if you’re ok with plan. :thumbsup:
Kai: 👍
Marcos: 👍
Priya: 👍
EvalBot: AGENT: eval job eval-20260318-11 finished. results: 100/100 ran, BERTScore delta=+0.0%, instruction pass=99%. artifacts: s3://repro/sora8b/eval/fp16-smoke.json
Anya: Nice — thanks EvalBot. We'll proceed to int8 calibrations today.
